title: Crawler Mucus

sources.title: Coatings
markers: | description = A subset of Potions, Coatings can apply a variety of harmful effects to weapons that aid in combat for a short period of time.

summary: Coat weapons to paralyse targets on a failed DC 13 Constitution save, or throw to create a cloud.

fields.Coat: Use one dose as a Bonus Action to coat the active weapon set for 10 turns, including both hands when dual wielding. Each set needs its own dose. Dipping and coating are mutually exclusive. A hit forces DC 13 Constitution against paralysis, with repeated saves at the end of turns.
fields.Throw: Use an Action to throw up to 60 ft. The impact uses DC 13 Constitution and can apply paralysis until a save or Long Rest. The 3 ft radius cloud lasts 1 turn, uses DC 11 Constitution and applies paralysis for 1 turn. The two modes are reported separately by the source.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Carrion Crawler Tentacle with any Vitriol.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
